contributionSummary: Generates OpenAPI 3.1 and Docusaurus references from API contract schemas and validates runtime route and method drift.

publicNote.description: Integrators can now browse and download a complete reference for Arbiter's supported v1 API, including sign-in and credential requirements, request and response shapes, stable errors, pagination, and rate limits. The published reference stays aligned with supported API behavior as Arbiter adds new capabilities.
